teaching.canDo: Compare the timing of chat and viewer changes without claiming causation from correlation.
teaching.keyIdea: Viewer counts can lag a chat change; use both signals and review the context.

explanation.text: Chat rate and viewer counts answer different questions. A viewer may remain present while chat participation changes. In the illustrative case chat fell sharply near the transition, while the viewer line initially held. The agency uses this sequence as an early warning and requires participation during grind or loading stretches under LW-4.1. It is a review prompt, not a universal law about lag times. Compare both traces, identify the segment and inspect the VOD. A quiet chat could have more than one explanation. Record the observed timing separately from the proposed content explanation.

example.title: Read chat as an early warning, then verify (illustrative)
example.scenario: The case chat rate fell from 87 messages at minute 37 to 15 at minute 41. The viewer line remained near its earlier level around minute 40 before declining. The agency treats chat rate as an early warning, but a quiet chat alone cannot identify a cause.
example.takeaway: Viewer counts can lag a chat change; use both signals and review the context.

checks.prompt: Which signal changed early in the case?
options: A change in the game logo

distractorRationale.Only the final stream average: error: Uses a whole-stream aggregate instead of the early signal
distractorRationale.A later incoming raid: error: Uses an event that happens much later
distractorRationale.A change in the game logo: error: Introduces a cosmetic change absent from the case

checks.explanation: The case trace shows the early chat decline; the later raid cannot explain the earlier sequence.

checks.prompt: What does LW-4.1 require during a grind?

distractorRationale.A new title only: error: Uses a title instead of viewer participation
distractorRationale.Silence until viewers leave: error: Waits for a lagging count instead of checking the warning
distractorRationale.Automatic edits by KiKi: error: Delegates execution instead of learner action

checks.explanation: The agency requires a participation mechanism; KiKi coaches while the creator performs the work.

checks.prompt: What follows from a quiet chat alone?
options: Proof the platform hid the stream

distractorRationale.The creator caused every departure: error: Infers individual causation from one trace
distractorRationale.The whole stream has failed: error: Extrapolates a local warning to the whole stream
distractorRationale.Proof the platform hid the stream: error: Invents a platform distribution explanation

checks.explanation: A warning guides a review; the trace alone cannot identify one cause or prove a platform action.

checks.prompt: What is the decline from 87 to 15 chat messages per minute?

distractorRationale.15 messages: error: Reports the final level rather than the decline
distractorRationale.41 messages: error: Uses the later sample minute as a message count
distractorRationale.87 messages: error: Reports the initial level rather than the decline

checks.explanation: Subtract the later rate from the earlier one. The size of the decline is separate from its cause.

checks.prompt: Which review best uses the early warning?
options: Compare both traces and inspect the VOD
Ignore chat while viewers are stable
checks.answer: Compare both traces and inspect the VOD

distractorRationale.Ignore chat while viewers are stable: error: Ignores a leading signal because the count still holds
distractorRationale.Infer a platform-wide lag rule: error: Generalises one illustrative lag to all streams
distractorRationale.Change several live settings immediately: error: Changes several variables before diagnosing the evidence

checks.explanation: Multiple traces and the VOD provide context; a single illustrative episode cannot establish a universal timing rule.
